symptoms: Committing a path in native Sneak mode produced no secret Sneak check.
The ruler distance did not show which Sneak action contained the waypoint.

liveDiagnosis.cause: Manual movement treated the stale empty encounter as authoritative and rejected every token as off-turn. The PF2e ruler had no action-cost provider for the custom Sneak movement action.

resolution: Manual Sneak uses subject-aware combat scope, matching Hide: empty and unrelated encounters fall back to scene movement.
Sneak ruler labels use half prepared ground Speed per action, or full Speed with Swift Sneak, and mark paths beyond three actions.
The secret check still occurs only when movement is committed; ruler preview performs no roll.
